    def run_full_diagnosis(self, train_loader):
        from itertools import islice

        view, network = self.view, self.view.model
        rng = np.random.default_rng(42)
        previous_modes = [(module, module.training) for module in network.modules()]
        python_state, numpy_state = random.getstate(), np.random.get_state()
        torch_state = torch.random.get_rng_state()
        cuda_state = (torch.cuda.get_rng_state(self.device)
                      if self.device.type == "cuda" else None)
        metrics = {}
        definitions = {
            "training_positions": "Descriptive position-weighted training statistics from at most ten batches, requiring nonzero sequence, positive and negative IDs. No independent-user inference.",
            "pos_neg_margin_mean": "Mean positive-minus-negative training score; scale dependent.",
            "pos_neg_margin_p10": "Nearest-rank tenth percentile of training margins.",
            "pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate": "Fraction of valid training margins below zero.",
            "pos_neg_small_margin_rate": "Fraction of valid training margins below 0.5; this threshold is scale dependent.",
            "pairwise_accuracy": "P(positive score > negative score) + 0.5 P(tie), conditional on sampled negative difficulty; invariant to strictly increasing score transformations.",
            "embedding_angular_alignment": "(Mean off-diagonal cosine + 1)/2; approximately 0.5 means zero mean cosine. Not a ranking-quality or semantic-diversity metric.",
            "representations": "Centered covariance eigenvalues for raw and unit-normalized vectors; total variance, largest eigenvalue share and exp(-sum(p log p)), where p is covariance eigenvalue mass. This is not RankMe. Zero variance has null effective rank.",
            "structure": "Inspection of actual NextItNet residual blocks, temporal convolutions, positionwise norms, biases, explicit causal padding and masks. Reachability is conditional on this recognized graph and absence of unrecognized operations.",
            "checks": "Feature comparisons in eval mode: atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5; report maximum absolute difference. Width checks retain item content but may change absolute positions.",
            "training_endpoint_interventions": "Fixed positive/negative endpoint pair, largest nonzero index, descriptive loader-row margin changes; rows are not identified independent users.",
            "user_score_sensitivity": "Identified public training users, fixed 99 training-observed unseen candidates per user. Mean absolute score change and signed mean score change; no relevance labels, HR or target ranks.",
            "temporal_geometry": "Strengths 0.25 and 0.5 use k=max(1,floor(fraction*retained_length)). Deletions compact and left-pad; replacements preserve positions; shuffles preserve identities and multiplicities. Eligibility is checked before averaging changed draws.",
            "user_intervals": "Pointwise 95% percentile intervals from 2000 seed-42 user bootstrap resamples. Each complete paired vector is resampled together within the current category and original-length stratum. Conditional on fitted model, fixed users/candidates; excludes training-seed, candidate-sampling and adaptive-search uncertainty. Exploratory, no p-values.",
            "missingness": "Unavailable observations are null with reasons, never zero-effect evidence. Cross-category macro estimates require all four categories.",
        }

        def summary(values):
            x = np.asarray(values, dtype=np.float64).reshape(-1)
            if not x.size:
                return {"n": 0, "mean": None, "reason": "No eligible observations"}
            if not np.isfinite(x).all():
                return {"n": int(x.size), "mean": None, "reason": "Nonfinite observations"}
            return {"n": int(x.size), "mean": float(x.mean()),
                    "p10": float(np.quantile(x, .1)),
                    "p50": float(np.quantile(x, .5)),
                    "p90": float(np.quantile(x, .9)),
                    "min": float(x.min()), "max": float(x.max())}

        def representation(x):
            x = x.detach().float().cpu().double()
            result = {"count": int(x.shape[0]),
                      "norms": summary(x.norm(dim=-1).numpy())}
            for name, z in (("raw", x), ("unit_normalized", F.normalize(x, dim=-1))):
                if len(z) < 2:
                    result[name] = {"total_variance": None, "effective_rank": None,
                                    "reason": "At least two vectors required"}
                    continue
                z = z - z.mean(0, keepdim=True)
                eig = torch.linalg.eigvalsh(z.T @ z / (len(z) - 1)).clamp_min(0)
                total = float(eig.sum())
                entry = {"eigenvalues": eig.tolist(), "total_variance": total,
                         "leading_share": None, "effective_rank": None}
                if total > 0:
                    p = eig[eig > 0] / total
                    entry.update(leading_share=float(eig[-1] / total),
                                 effective_rank=float(torch.exp(-(p * p.log()).sum())))
                else:
                    entry["reason"] = "Zero centered variance"
                result[name] = entry
            return result

        def encode(seq):
            return view.log2feats(torch.as_tensor(seq, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device))

        def endpoint(seq):
            positions = torch.arange(seq.shape[1], device=seq.device).expand_as(seq)
            return positions.masked_fill(seq == 0, -1).max(1).values

        def final_features(sequences):
            seq = torch.as_tensor(np.asarray(sequences), dtype=torch.long, device=self.device)
            last = endpoint(seq)
            if (last < 0).any():
                raise ValueError("All-padding history cannot be scored by diagnostics")
            feats = encode(seq)
            return feats[torch.arange(len(seq), device=self.device), last]

        def score_vectors(sequences, candidates):
            output = []
            for start in range(0, len(sequences), 32):
                feats = final_features(sequences[start:start + 32])
                # One feature vector and one candidate list per call preserves
                # ModelView implementations accepting arbitrary item-list shapes.
                output.extend(view.predict_score(f, candidates).detach().float().cpu().numpy()
                              for f in feats)
            return np.asarray(output)

        def compare(a, b):
            return {"max_absolute_difference": float((a - b).abs().max()),
                    "within_tolerance": bool(torch.allclose(a, b, atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-5))}

        def inspect_structure():
            convs = [{"name": name, "kernel": list(m.kernel_size),
                      "dilation": list(m.dilation), "stride": list(m.stride),
                      "padding": list(m.padding), "bias": m.bias is not None}
                     for name, m in network.named_modules() if isinstance(m, torch.nn.Conv1d)]
            norms = [{"name": name, "type": type(m).__name__,
                      "normalized_shape": list(m.normalized_shape) if isinstance(m, torch.nn.LayerNorm) else None}
                     for name, m in network.named_modules()
                     if isinstance(m, (torch.nn.LayerNorm, torch.nn.BatchNorm1d,
                                       torch.nn.InstanceNorm1d, torch.nn.GroupNorm))]
            recognized = type(network).__name__ == "NextItNetModel"
            recognized &= hasattr(network, "blocks") and hasattr(network, "depth_norms")
            offsets, all_depths = {0}, set()
            if recognized:
                recognized &= len(convs) == 2 * len(network.blocks)
                for block in network.blocks:
                    recognized &= type(block).__name__ == "NextItNetBlock"
                    branch = set(offsets)
                    for conv in (block.conv1, block.conv2):
                        recognized &= (conv.stride == (1,) and conv.padding == (0,)
                                       and conv.kernel_size == (block.kernel_size,)
                                       and conv.dilation == (block.dilation,))
                        branch = {o + j * conv.dilation[0] for o in branch
                                  for j in range(conv.kernel_size[0])}
                    offsets |= branch
                    all_depths |= offsets
                recognized &= all(n["type"] == "LayerNorm" and
                                  n["normalized_shape"] == [network.hidden_units] for n in norms)
            return {"convolutions": convs, "normalizations": norms,
                    "recognized_baseline_graph": bool(recognized),
                    "reachable_endpoint_offsets": sorted(all_depths) if recognized else None,
                    "receptive_field_span": max(all_depths) + 1 if recognized and all_depths else None,
                    "padding_and_masks": "Recognized baseline explicitly left-pads each convolution and masks before/after convolutions, normalization and residual paths" if recognized else None,
                    "locality_caveat": "Conditional on supplied baseline forward graph; empirical checks below corroborate but do not prove locality"}

        try:
            network.eval()
            with torch.no_grad():
                metrics["structure"] = inspect_structure()
                itemnum = int(network.itemnum)
                weights = view.item_emb.weight.detach()
                real_count = min(itemnum, len(weights) - 1)
                indices = rng.choice(np.arange(1, real_count + 1),
                                     min(2048, real_count), replace=False)
                sample = weights[torch.as_tensor(indices, device=weights.device)]
                metrics["item_representations"] = representation(sample)
                if len(sample) > 1:
                    unit = F.normalize(sample.float(), dim=-1)
                    cosine = (unit.sum(0).square().sum() - unit.square().sum()) / (len(unit) * (len(unit) - 1))
                    metrics["embedding_angular_alignment"] = float((cosine.clamp(-1, 1) + 1) / 2)
                else:
                    metrics["embedding_angular_alignment"] = None
                margins, positives, negatives, final_states = [], [], [], []
                endpoint_effects = []
                batch_count, valid_count = 0, 0
                for batch in islice(iter(train_loader), 10):
                    _, sequence, positive, negative = batch
                    seq, pos, neg = [torch.as_tensor(x, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device)
                                     for x in (sequence, positive, negative)]
                    feats = encode(seq)
                    # Score the two B x L tensors separately: the actual NextItNet
                    # scorer multiplies B x L x D features and item embeddings.
                    ps, ns = view.predict_score(feats, pos), view.predict_score(feats, neg)
                    valid = (seq != 0) & (pos != 0) & (neg != 0)
                    margins.extend((ps - ns)[valid].float().cpu().tolist())
                    positives.extend(ps[valid].float().cpu().tolist())
                    negatives.extend(ns[valid].float().cpu().tolist())
                    valid_count += int(valid.sum())
                    batch_count += 1
                    last = endpoint(seq)
                    rows = torch.where(last >= 0)[0]
                    final_states.append(feats[rows, last[rows]].detach().cpu())
                    if batch_count == 1 and len(rows):
                        checks = {"identity": compare(feats, encode(seq)),
                                  "batch_reordering": compare(feats, encode(seq.flip(0)).flip(0)),
                                  "input_width": int(seq.shape[1])}
                        row = int(rows[0])
                        nonzero = torch.where(seq[row] != 0)[0]
                        checks["retained_history"] = int(len(nonzero))
                        if len(nonzero) >= 2 and real_count >= 2:
                            pivot = int(nonzero[len(nonzero) // 2 - 1])
                            altered = seq[row:row + 1].clone()
                            future = torch.arange(seq.shape[1], device=self.device) > pivot
                            future &= altered[0] != 0
                            altered[0, future] = altered[0, future] % real_count + 1
                            checks["future_token_causality"] = dict(
                                compare(feats[row, :pivot + 1], encode(altered)[0, :pivot + 1]),
                                pivot=pivot, changed_tokens=int(future.sum()))
                        offsets = metrics["structure"]["reachable_endpoint_offsets"]
                        if offsets is not None and real_count >= 2:
                            end = int(last[row])
                            outside = [int(i) for i in nonzero if end - int(i) not in offsets]
                            if outside:
                                altered = seq[row:row + 1].clone()
                                altered[0, outside] = altered[0, outside] % real_count + 1
                                checks["outside_reachable_offsets"] = dict(
                                    compare(feats[row, end], encode(altered)[0, end]),
                                    changed_lags=[end - i for i in outside])
                            else:
                                checks["outside_reachable_offsets"] = {"value": None, "reason": "No retained tokens outside reachable offsets"}
                        width_checks = []
                        first = int(nonzero[0])
                        for remove in sorted({1, first // 2, first}):
                            if not 0 < remove <= first:
                                continue
                            shortened = seq[row:row + 1, remove:]
                            try:
                                width_checks.append(dict(compare(feats[row, last[row]], final_features(shortened.cpu().numpy())[0]),
                                                         input_width=int(shortened.shape[1]), removed_leading_padding=remove,
                                                         absolute_positions_shifted=hasattr(network, "pos_emb")))
                            except (RuntimeError, ValueError, IndexError) as exc:
                                width_checks.append({"value": None, "input_width": int(shortened.shape[1]), "reason": str(exc)})
                        checks["leading_padding_widths"] = width_checks or {"value": None, "reason": "No removable leading padding"}
                        metrics["checks"] = checks
                        for r in rows[:8].tolist():
                            e = int(last[r])
                            if not bool(valid[r, e]):
                                continue
                            history = seq[r][seq[r] != 0].cpu().numpy()
                            if len(history) < 2:
                                continue
                            pair = torch.stack((pos[r, e], neg[r, e]))
                            baseline = float(ps[r, e] - ns[r, e])
                            for fraction in (.25, .5):
                                k = max(1, int(fraction * len(history)))
                                for region, kept in (("old", history[k:]), ("recent", history[:-k])):
                                    altered = np.zeros(seq.shape[1], dtype=np.int64)
                                    altered[-len(kept):] = kept
                                    scores = score_vectors([altered], pair)[0]
                                    endpoint_effects.append({"fraction": fraction, "region": region,
                                                             "retained_length": len(history), "deleted": k,
                                                             "margin_change": float(scores[0] - scores[1] - baseline)})
                m = np.asarray(margins)
                metrics["training_positions"] = {"batches": batch_count, "valid_positions": valid_count,
                                                  "margins": summary(m), "positive_scores": summary(positives),
                                                  "negative_scores": summary(negatives)}
                metrics["pos_neg_margin_mean"] = float(m.mean()) if len(m) else None
                metrics["pos_neg_margin_p10"] = float(np.sort(m)[max(0, int(np.ceil(.1 * len(m))) - 1)]) if len(m) else None
                metrics["pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate"] = float((m < 0).mean()) if len(m) else None
                metrics["pos_neg_small_margin_rate"] = float((m < .5).mean()) if len(m) else None
                metrics["pairwise_accuracy"] = float(((m > 0) + .5 * (m == 0)).mean()) if len(m) else None
                metrics["training_endpoint_interventions"] = endpoint_effects
                metrics["loader_endpoint_representations"] = (representation(torch.cat(final_states))
                                                              if final_states else {"count": 0, "reason": "No nonpadding rows"})

                histories = self.user_train.get("History", self.user_train)
                if not isinstance(histories, dict):
                    raise TypeError("ModelView user_train must expose mapped item histories")
                # Histories must already use the baseline's integer item mapping.
                ordered = sorted(histories, key=lambda x: (type(x).__name__, str(x)))
                chosen = sorted(rng.choice(len(ordered), min(200, len(ordered)), replace=False).tolist())
                frequencies = Counter(int(i) for h in histories.values() for i in h if 1 <= int(i) <= real_count)
                observed = np.asarray(sorted(frequencies), dtype=np.int64)
                ordered_frequency = sorted(observed.tolist(), key=lambda i: (frequencies[i], i))
                decile = {item: min(9, 10 * rank // max(1, len(ordered_frequency)))
                          for rank, item in enumerate(ordered_frequency)}
                pools = {d: np.asarray([i for i in observed if decile[int(i)] == d], dtype=np.int64)
                         for d in range(10)}
                maxlen = int(network.maxlen)
                user_rows, skips = [], Counter()

                def padded(history):
                    array = np.zeros(maxlen, dtype=np.int64)
                    array[-len(history):] = history
                    return array

                for index in chosen:
                    uid = ordered[index]
                    original = np.asarray(histories[uid], dtype=np.int64)
                    if not len(original) or np.any((original < 1) | (original > real_count)):
                        skips["empty_or_unmapped_history"] += 1
                        continue
                    h = original[-maxlen:]
                    unseen = observed[~np.isin(observed, original)]
                    if len(unseen) < 99:
                        skips["fewer_than_99_training_observed_unseen_candidates"] += 1
                        continue
                    candidates = rng.choice(unseen, 99, replace=False)
                    cand_t = torch.as_tensor(candidates, dtype=torch.long, device=self.device)
                    intact = padded(h)
                    baseline = score_vectors([intact], cand_t)[0]
                    variants, labels, geometry = [intact.copy()], ["identity"], [{"changed": 0}]
                    unavailable = Counter()

                    def add(label, history, metadata):
                        array = padded(history)
                        if np.array_equal(array, intact):
                            unavailable[label + ":unchanged"] += 1
                            return
                        variants.append(array)
                        labels.append(label)
                        geometry.append(metadata)

                    for fraction in (.25, .5):
                        n, k = len(h), max(1, int(fraction * len(h)))
                        prefix = str(fraction) + ":"
                        if n <= k:
                            unavailable[prefix + "insufficient_remaining_history"] += 1
                            continue
                        regions = {"old": np.arange(k), "recent": np.arange(n - k, n)}
                        if n - k >= k:
                            regions["random"] = np.sort(rng.choice(n - k, k, replace=False))
                        else:
                            unavailable[prefix + "random:cannot_preserve_newest_k"] += 1
                        if n - k - 1 >= k:
                            regions["interior"] = np.sort(rng.choice(np.arange(1, n - k), k, replace=False))
                        else:
                            unavailable[prefix + "interior:cannot_preserve_newest_k"] += 1
                        for name, positions in regions.items():
                            metadata = {"k": k, "original_length": len(original), "retained_length": n,
                                        "input_width": maxlen, "lags": (n - 1 - positions).tolist(),
                                        "newest_k_preserved": bool(np.all(positions < n - k))}
                            add(prefix + name + "_delete", np.delete(h, positions), metadata)
                            zeros = h.copy()
                            zeros[positions] = 0
                            add(prefix + name + "_zero", zeros, metadata)
                            replacements = h.copy()
                            unmatched = 0
                            for p in positions:

                                options = options[~np.isin(options, forbidden)]
                                if not len(options):

                                    options = observed[~np.isin(observed, forbidden)]
                                if not len(options):

                                replacements[p] = rng.choice(options)
                            else:
                                add(prefix + name + "_replace", replacements,
                                    dict(metadata, unmatched_frequency_decile=unmatched))
                                continue
                            unavailable[prefix + name + "_replace:no_alternative"] += 1
                        for name, positions in (("recent", np.arange(n - k, n)),
                                                ("old", np.arange(n - k))):

                                unavailable[prefix + name + "_shuffle:insufficient_distinct_items"] += 1
                                continue
                            for draw in range(20):
                                altered = h.copy()
                                altered[positions] = rng.permutation(h[positions])
                                add(prefix + name + "_shuffle", altered,
                                    {"k": k, "region_size": len(positions), "draw": draw,
                                     "lags": (n - 1 - positions).tolist(), "retained_length": n,
                                     "input_width": maxlen})

                    effects = {}
                    for label in dict.fromkeys(labels):
                        indices = [i for i, label_i in enumerate(labels) if label_i == label]
                        delta = scores[indices] - baseline
                        effects[label] = {"mean_absolute_score_change": float(np.abs(delta).mean()),

                                          "changed_draws": len(indices),
                                          "geometry": [geometry[i] for i in indices]}
                    user_rows.append({"user_id": str(uid), "original_length": len(original),
                                      "retained_length": len(h), "effects": effects,
                                      "ineligible": dict(unavailable)})

                bootstrap_rng = np.random.default_rng(42)

                def aggregate(rows, names):
                    if not rows:
                        return {"eligible_users": 0, "estimates": None, "reason": "No common eligible users"}
                    columns = [(name, field) for name in names for field in
                               ("mean_absolute_score_change", "signed_mean_score_change")]
                    values = np.asarray([[r["effects"][name][field] for name, field in columns] for r in rows])
                    draws = bootstrap_rng.integers(0, len(rows), size=(2000, len(rows)))
                    means = values[draws].mean(axis=1)
                    bounds = np.quantile(means, [.025, .975], axis=0)
                    return {"eligible_users": len(rows), "estimates": {
                        name + ":" + field: {"mean": float(values[:, j].mean()),
                                              "ci95": bounds[:, j].tolist()}
                        for j, (name, field) in enumerate(columns)}}

                groups = {"all": lambda r: True,
                          "1-10": lambda r: r["original_length"] <= 10,
                          "11-25": lambda r: 11 <= r["original_length"] <= 25,
                          "26+": lambda r: r["original_length"] >= 26}
                methods = sorted({name for row in user_rows for name in row["effects"]})
                aggregates, common = {}, {}
                for group, predicate in groups.items():
                    rows = [r for r in user_rows if predicate(r)]
                    aggregates[group] = {name: aggregate([r for r in rows if name in r["effects"]], [name])
                                         for name in methods}
                    common[group] = {}
                    for fraction in (.25, .5):
                        prefix = str(fraction) + ":"
                        families = {"deletions": ["old_delete", "recent_delete", "random_delete", "interior_delete"],
                                    "old_geometry_controls": ["old_delete", "old_zero", "old_replace"],
                                    "shuffles": ["old_shuffle", "recent_shuffle"]}
                        for family, suffixes in families.items():

                            paired = [r for r in rows if all(name in r["effects"] for name in names)]
                            common[group][prefix + family] = aggregate(paired, names)

                    "selected_users": len(chosen), "eligible_users": len(user_rows),
